description: This file defines a TRPC router for schedule-related operations, including CRUD actions and fetching schedules by various criteria. It imports schemas, handlers, and sets up route procedures with authentication.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles fetching a schedule by ID or criteria using an authenticated procedure.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new schedule entry via an authenticated mutation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deleting a schedule entry via an authenticated mutation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing schedule entry via an authenticated mutation.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Handles duplicating a schedule entry via an authenticated mutation.

methods.name: getScheduleByUserId
methods.description: Fetches schedules associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: getAllSchedulesByUserId
methods.description: Fetches all schedules for a specific user ID.

methods.name: bulkUpdateToDefaultAvailability
methods.description: Performs bulk update to set default availability for schedules.
